question: Should known-context agent runs cap explicit and current compaction reserveTokens to the safe prompt-budget maximum, even when a user configured or persisted a higher reserve?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it deliberately changes effective config-backed behavior and overlaps active explicit-reserve semantics work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94798.

options.title: Accept the narrow cap
options.body: Land this PR’s reserve cap as the compatibility tradeoff for preventing small-context compaction loops, while leaving omitted-floor and keepRecent policy to separate work.

options.title: Preserve oversized explicit reserves
options.body: Change the PR so only runtime defaults or floors are capped, preserving user-selected reserves even when they can consume the known context window.

options.title: Pause for one compaction contract
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle reserve floor, explicit reserve, keepRecent, and percentage-style budget semantics together.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow cap
recommendation.body: Land this PR’s reserve cap as the compatibility tradeoff for preventing small-context compaction loops, while leaving omitted-floor and keepRecent policy to separate work.
